description: 海岸保全区域台帳 [sediment-control and coastal defences] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 四日市市. 津波等の被害から防護するための堤防の長さ等がわかります。. Coverage: 四日市市. The portal files it under the publisher 四日市市. Its tags are 水産業, 防災. It offers 2 resource(s) in xlsx. The portal shows 2024-01-25 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
